integration.input_sampling: none: LEDC has no physical input signals

features.name: target-register-file
features.detail: 8 channels / 4 timers, aligned 32-bit little-endian accesses, masks, read-only counters/current duty, WO strobes read zero, IRQ RAW/ST/ENA/W1C, writable DATE 0x19040200 reset; timer reset bit23 defaults1; bit24 reserved despite IDF struct tick_sel label
features.date_source_precedence: Pinned S3 IDF6.1 ledc_reg.h:1550 documents 0x19040200. TRM v1.8 35.5 Register35.13 page1325 instead diagrams 0x19072601. This target follows the pinned SDK register header; discrepancy is explicit, not silicon-qualified.

features.name: ordinary-pwm
features.detail: Real digital output edges, period 2^resolution, integer duty plus hpoint phase, full/zero duty, driven idle on disabled channel, all 8 independent outputs and 4 timebases; no intensity/average output. Only changed channels publish through one electrical batch; reset forces full re-publication; unchanged MMIO polling does not settle the electrical graph.

features.name: shadow-updates
features.detail: Strobes snapshot divider/resolution and enable/timer/hpoint/overflow-counter-enable; running timer wrap commits them. Fade parameters/current duty commit immediately; output duty width sampled on timer wrap. Initial reset/unconfigured counter accepts shadow state before start.

features.name: fractional-divider
features.detail: A/A+1 integer source cycle intervals via bounded modulo256 accumulator; no fictional continuous fractional tick. Prescaler accumulator and residual billionth-cycle phase survive divider/clock/gate/pause changes.

features.name: fractional-duty
features.detail: Low nibble dithers integer pulse widths over 16 periods, persistent modulo16 accumulator; not a fractional sub-tick edge

features.name: fade
features.detail: Increasing/decreasing duty by SCALE per CYCLE selected-timer wraps for NUM changes, DUTY_R live19-bit value; IRQ bits4..11 latch completion; fade_start and data writes require channel strobe; conf0-only updates do not restart unchanged fade

features.name: timer-and-channel-overflow-irq
features.detail: Timer wrap RAW0..3 and enabled overflow-count thresholds NUM+1 RAW12..19; modulo threshold counter, WO reset; asserted level IRQ RAW&ENA

features.name: clock-gate-reset-idle
features.detail: Common APB/RC_FAST/XTAL selectors1/2/3, selector0 disconnected. CONF.CLK_EN is automatic register-clock gating override, not waveform enable. SYSTEM gate/pause retain count/phase/output; reset clears output to driven low idle; held reset rejects writes.

features.name: bounded-scheduling
features.detail: One persistent QEMUTimer, 4 fixed timer states, 8 fixed channel states, no per-edge allocations. Next comparator/wrap deadline rounded upward to virtual nanoseconds with source-phase carry. Binary counter advance bounded14 iterations; catch-up max16 wraps/timer/callback, residual backlog retained and callback scheduled no earlier than now+1ns.

missing_primary_source_semantics.topic: initial fractional divider and duty dither ordering
missing_primary_source_semantics.missing: TRM specifies even distribution/count but does not specify accumulator seed or precise 256/16-cycle ordering
missing_primary_source_semantics.policy: zero seed, modulo carry; tests pin model convention, not a silicon oracle

missing_primary_source_semantics.missing: TRM describes sum comparator but does not specify counter-width truncation vs resolution-modulus wrap and match priority
missing_primary_source_semantics.policy: width spans timer modulus; zero width low/full width high; hpoint outside period retains previous signal state; these corner cases not hardware-qualified

missing_primary_source_semantics.missing: TRM specifies next wrap but not what initially reset/unconfigured timer does with PARA_UP
missing_primary_source_semantics.policy: commit when reset/unconfigured to permit real IDF start; pauses otherwise retain pending shadow

missing_primary_source_semantics.missing: exact zero NUM/CYCLE behavior, underflow/overflow duty saturation and DUTY_START auto-clear not documented
missing_primary_source_semantics.policy: CYCLE0 treated as one wrap; NUM0 completes after one cycle; 19-bit modulo duty arithmetic; DUTY_START guest value retained after completion

missing_primary_source_semantics.topic: fade time origin and first sample ordering
missing_primary_source_semantics.missing: strobe vs first-wrap phase and re-arm of unchanged start bit not cycle-level specified
missing_primary_source_semantics.policy: restart on dirty duty/conf1 strobe, count subsequent wraps, apply step before sampled width; conf0-only strobes preserve fade

missing_primary_source_semantics.topic: overflow counter reset status handshake and threshold re-arm
missing_primary_source_semantics.missing: RO reset-status timing and threshold saturation/auto-rearm not described
missing_primary_source_semantics.policy: reset accepted synchronously so status reads0; counters periodically re-arm modulo NUM+1

missing_primary_source_semantics.topic: bus access while SYSTEM clock disabled
missing_primary_source_semantics.missing: TRM does not specify QEMU-visible return value or transaction behavior
missing_primary_source_semantics.policy: reads0/writes ignored while SYSTEM gate/reset held; gated output retained

missing_primary_source_semantics.missing: not a silicon semantic: virtual callbacks may arrive after multiple comparator deadlines
missing_primary_source_semantics.policy: bounded catch-up produces current-time resolved state, not invented historical electrical publications; exact edge-sequence qualification requires normal deadline dispatch
